name: AI Stream Answer
description: A question bubble pops in, a "Thinking" label shimmers, then the answer streams token by token behind a glowing caret and finishes by building a bar chart and source chips.
move: A question bubble pops in, a "Thinking" label shimmers, then the answer streams token by token behind a glowing caret and finishes by building a bar chart and source chips.
how: The answer is split into token spans laid out from the start (no reflow). Arrival times come from a seeded RNG (40–90ms with occasional chunk pauses); each token fades up from a 4px blur over 0.22s. The caret glides to each token on the same line and jumps on wraps. Thinking shimmer is a background-position sweep on clipped text. Bars scaleY from the base with cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1).
adapt: Change the question, answer (bold runs stay bold) and chart values. Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Timeline-driven: register the page's CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot and rebuild the timeline; state painted in onUpdate must stay a function of tl.time().
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
